_notes_gravity: Gravity on a surface (gravity design doc, 'Gravity model' / 'Gravity effects'; game/sim/Surface/GravityProfile.cs). A surface's gravity is its climate body's gravity_g if climate.json gives one, else its class environment's gravity_g (environments.json). bands name a world (UI, later gates): below_g = upper edge, the last is null. effects: one curve per effect, points [g, multiplier] sorted by g, interpolated linearly and clamped at the ends; normalise_to = a planet class whose gravity gives exactly x1 everywhere (each multiplier is divided by its value at that class's gravity, so class M plays exactly as tuned; null = raw curves). Where each plugs in: drive_speed = every ground vehicle's speed (wheels and tracks alike for now); rover_wear = rover wear and flat-tyre chances while driving; descent_time = the first landing's descent, outpost drops and the drop ship's flight; lift_cost = the drop ship's fuel a trip (orbit.json shuttle.fuel); pod_speed = mining-crawler cargo pods; build_time = construction, levels and core upgrades; build_cost = the metal part of building, level and upgrade costs (build_cost_resources); extraction = mines, deep-core mines and crawler digging; crew_work = crews on foot: survey teams (on_foot), the maintenance crew's walk and repair rate, the vehicle repair rate on the pad. hills: above 1 g, the move cost of these terrains x (1 + cost_per_g_above_1 x (g - 1)). Not yet: the rollover hazard, dust linger, building height, combat. All numbers are placeholders.

effects.applies: first landing, outpost drops, drop ships
crews on foot: walking and repairs

_notes_habitability: Habitability tiers (gravity design doc, 'Life and habitability limits'; game/sim/Surface/Habitability.cs). A world's tier is the worst of six checks on its class environment (and its body's gravity), fixed for the game: gravity_g; pressure_kpa (sea level); o2_pct; gas_limit_x = the worst main or trace gas against telemetry exposure_limits_ppm, at sea-level-equivalent ppm (ppm x pressure / 101.3); temperature_c = the environment's night low and day high must both fit; radiation_usv_h by day. Each check lists, per tier, the range a value must lie in to need no more than that tier (ranges nest: each tier's range holds the cheaper tiers'); a value outside every range is Impossible. The Open ranges of pressure, O2, temperature and radiation are the telemetry limits (breathable_kpa, breathable_o2_pct, cold_warn_c..heat_warn_c, below radiation_warn_usv_h), so they are not repeated here. 2026-11-08 (owner): O2 below 16% now needs Domes (the doc had Masks down to 12%), so class L (Veyra: O2 13.5%, CO2 4.5%) is a Domes world; class M stays Open. domes: what a Domes-tier (or Tech-tier) world adds. Crewed buildings (buildings.json crewed) may only be placed under cover: within core_dome_radius tiles of a finished colony core (its containment field) or within a finished building's dome_radius (Pressure Dome 2). build_menu = buildings added to the build menu on such worlds only. Life support per base: supply = life_support of its working buildings (cores, the Life Support Plant) x condition x the base's power share; use = life_support_per_crewed for each finished crewed building that isn't paused; below 1 every crewed building there works at supply / use; at 0 for grace_seconds the base is failing and loses crew_loss_per_min crew a minute for each crewed building, from stock, until supply is back. Vehicles: every rover counts as sealed for now (no exposure loss). All numbers are placeholders.
